title: Anchorless KV profiling and version-affinity audit for long-context workloads
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary:
We need an "anchorless" profiling and audit pipeline that computes per-model version-affinity signals across sequence-length distributions so that automated pinning and profile publishing avoid regressions for long-context workloads. Current anchor-based signatures miss cases where tokenization or prompt framing causes unstable K/V residency; this ticket delivers a complementary metric set and gating for profile publish/pin flows.

Background:
- Existing onboarding uses anchor signatures and sequence-cluster profiles. In production we observed versions that pass anchor checks but show degraded tail latency or eviction sensitivity on real sequence distributions.
- Problem is most visible for multi-tenant models or mixed-tokenization prompts where anchors are rare or unstable.

Goals / What this ticket delivers:
- A new "version affinity" artifact for each model-version: numeric scores (kv_hit_rate, eviction_sensitivity, tail_latency_index, stability_index) measured across a configurable set of sampled sequence clusters and lengths.
- An "anchorless" profiling job that exercises warmup + KV-access traces using sampled sequences (no fixed anchor tokens required).
- Safety gates in the publish/pin pipeline: version-affinity thresholds that must be satisfied before automatic pinning or profile publishing to runtime catalogs.
- Per-model dashboard and alerting for affinity regressions and sudden affinity divergence between versions.

Acceptance criteria (must be true to move to In Review):
- Profiling job exists in the performance-runner repo and produces per-model JSON artifacts named affinity-v<semver>-<date>.json.
- Affinity artifact schema documented and discoverable from the model catalog UI.
- Publish/pin workflow refuses automatic pin when eviction_sensitivity or tail_latency_index regresses beyond configured deltas; a manual override flow is available with signoff.
- End-to-end canary: run against 5 representative models (one GPT-style 7B, one encoder-decoder, one large-decoder 70B, one quantized variant, one sparse-tokenized model) and verify metrics for at least 90% of sampled clusters.
- Dashboards show historic affinity trends and an alert rule triggers when stability_index drops > 12% vs baseline.

Design / Implementation notes:
1) Sampling: use the sequence-cluster sampling service to pull N=5000 sequences per model weighted by recent production traffic. Include short/medium/long buckets and tail samples.
2) Runner: re-use perf-runner harness to spin up model-versions in a test pool and execute warmup traces; record KV cache hits, eviction events, per-request token latency. No anchor tokens required; sequences are fully replayed.
3) Metrics computed for each (model,version,cluster,length_bucket): kv_hit_rate (float), eviction_sensitivity (float), p50/p95/p99 token latency, stability_index (rolling-window stddev normalized). Aggregate into a version-affinity summary.
4) Schema and storage: publish artifact to model-catalog S3 prefix and register metadata in catalog service. Artifact must be a flat JSON map (no nested objects) for easy consumption by publish flow.
5) Safety gates: add check in profile-publisher that compares candidate version affinity vs pinned baseline. Configurable deltas (default: -5% kv_hit_rate, +10% tail_latency_index, +8% eviction_sensitivity).
6) Manual override: when gate fails, block auto-publish and create a review task in Console with links to artifacts and a one-click signoff for Safety Engineers.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 1 (staging): implement runner and artifact generation, run nightly jobs for target models (2 weeks).
- Phase 2 (canary): enable gating for a small set of auto-publish rules on non-critical model channels and test manual override flow (1 week).
- Phase 3 (gradual): expand to all models and enable alerting; require org-wide signoff for broad pin automation (2 weeks).

Telemetry and dashboards:
- New dashboards: "Version Affinity Overview", "Affinity Drift by Model", and "Affinity Gate Failures".
- Telemetry events: affinity_artifact_published, affinity_gate_passed, affinity_gate_failed, manual_override_signed.
- Alert: stability_index_drop_incident -> triggers SE oncall + #kvcache-alerts.

Testing:
- Unit tests for metric computation logic with synthetic traces.
- Integration tests validating artifact schema and publish flow against a sandbox catalog.
- Canary perf runs with production-sampled sequences and comparison harness.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: sampling bias may not capture rare tail tokens -> mitigate by periodically including true tail logs and heavy-tail sampling.
- Risk: extra perf-runner load on test pool -> run in dedicated scaling pool and limit concurrent profiles.
- Risk: false positives block needed patches -> allow manual override with mandatory signoff metadata and audited logs.

Open questions:
- How to choose per-model delta thresholds? Suggest starting with model-family defaults and refine by historical analysis.
- Do we include embeddings-only models? Proposal: exclude unless KV semantics exist.

Links and artifacts:
- Confluence design doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INF/Anchorless+KV+Affinity+Audit
- GH epic: https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf-runner/labels/affinity-audit
- Perf dashboard prototype: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/affinity-overview
